caption: The drawing depicts a single glass goblet with a wide bowl, narrow stem, and broad, rounded base. The glass is clear with reflective highlights, giving a sense of transparency. Around the rim of the bowl is a twisted blue and white decorative border. The base of the goblet features embedded or surface decorations that include a central green-and-white motif with a touch of red, surrounded by blue, red, and white circular patterns, as well as a border of smaller alternating red and green circular accents. The background is a plain, beige color with no additional elements. The artist’s signature, “Stewart,” appears near the bottom right of the base.
title: Paper Weight
